agentiscapitaladvisors-agentis-capital-a.title: Analyst - Principal Investments
agentiscapitaladvisors-agentis-capital-a.description: OUR FIRM Agentis Capital Partners ("ACP") operates as the family office of the founding partners of Agentis, a diversified platform with businesses spanning principal investments, financial advisory, capital markets, and asset management services. Since its founding in 2009, the Agentis platform has advised on more than $30bn of transactions across infrastructure, mining, and energy, while ACP has built and managed a long-standing portfolio of principal investments across technology, industrial, and mixed industrial-technology businesses. ACP actively pursues both active and passive principal investments and currently manages a portfolio of more than 20 businesses. The firm has consistently made principal investments over the past decade, recycling capital into high-value opportunities and working closely with management teams and boards to create long-term value. YOUR CONTRIBUTION As an integral member of the principal investments team, you will work directly with the founding partners of Agentis on principal activities and will work with members of the advisory team where Agentis is making an investment in or alongside a client. You will work directly with C-suite executives and board members of Agentis portfolio companies and potential investments. Your role will include: - Researching potential investment opportunities; providing research on target companies, sectors, industries, and geographies - Evaluating investment opportunities and participating in the execution of principal investments - Developing financial models with a range of complexity for principal transactions - Assisting in the management of due diligence processes, including managing third-party advisors - Assisting in developing the strategy, business plan, and objectives of portfolio investments - Managing and aggregating asset-level reporting for portfolio investments As a member of a high-performing team working in a fast-paced environment, you will be required to work beyond a normal workday or workweek to fulfill your responsibilities. OUR DIFFERENTIATORS - Breadth of experience and level of responsibility - Exceptional level of responsibility on complex transactions and assets - Direct engagement with founding partners, C-suite executives of portfolio investments, and board members of portfolio investments - Wide breadth of work across industries - Training - Continuous internal training program - Internal leadership development program - Culture and approach - Entrepreneurial culture with a flat organization structure - Defined path to achieving Partner, with all individuals joining a Partner-track role receiving the opportunity to become a full Partner in the business - Compensation and employee ownership - Exceptional compensation versus the market for those who deliver exceptional performance, with uncapped performance-based bonuses - Employee ownership program that commences for all individuals from the end of their first full fiscal year of employment - Other benefits - Immediate access to principal investment opportunities alongside Partners - Paid sabbatical every two years of employment - Ability to work temporarily out of our Vancouver or Toronto office YOUR BACKGROUND AND SKILLS - An undergraduate degree in accounting, finance, commerce, business, statistics, computer science or other related fields - Exceptional academic results (minimum cGPA of 80% or 3.7/4.0) - Ability to concisely communicate complex concepts and ideas verbally and in writing - Ability to take initiative and work independently with minimal supervision - Desire to assume increasing levels of responsibility and seek solutions to complex problems - Committed to producing accurate and thorough work product under tight deadlines - Ability to learn quickly and adapt in a fast-paced work environment - Resilient mindset in the face of adversity - Ability to work effectively in a team environment POSITION TYPE - Permanent Full-Time - Desired start date: Immediate - Location: Va

jobgether-jobgether:lever:381f9f11-0c3d-.title: Sr. UI/UX Designer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:381f9f11-0c3d-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. UI/UX Designer based in Denmark. This is a senior design role focused on creating intuitive, polished, and engaging digital experiences across web and mobile products. You’ll work at the intersection of creative design and technical execution, partnering closely with developers and creative teams. The role offers ownership from early concepts and user flows through high-fidelity designs and interactive prototypes. You’ll bring strong visual design fundamentals while considering usability, responsiveness, accessibility, and how products are actually built. AI-powered design tools will be part of the workflow, helping you explore ideas and prototype quickly without compromising quality. You’ll have the opportunity to work on conventional and experimental digital experiences, with room to contribute creative ideas and new approaches. This is a fully remote position requiring strong communication, autonomy, attention to detail, and availability during AEST working hours. Design intuitive, high-quality user interfaces and experiences for web and mobile products, balancing usability, aesthetics, and technical feasibility. Translate briefs, business objectives, and product requirements into user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity designs, and polished digital experiences. Develop interactive prototypes in Figma that effectively communicate user behaviour, interactions, transitions, and overall product experience. Establish and maintain strong visual design systems, applying disciplined grids, spacing, typography, hierarchy, and responsive layouts. Use AI-powered design and creative tools to accelerate ideation, exploration, and rapid prototyping while maintaining a high standard of design quality. Collaborate closely with developers and technical teams throughout the design process to ensure accurate and practical implementation. Present design concepts and decisions clearly to colleagues, clients, and stakeholders, incorporating feedback while confidently explaining design rationale. Take ownership of projects from initial concept through final delivery, identifying problems and developing thoughtful, creative solutions. Help structure and organise design work, documentation, and workflows so projects progress efficiently across distributed teams. Contribute to experimental and innovative digital experiences, including immersive websites, animations, micro-interactions, and other emerging design approaches where relevant. Requirements: 5+ years of professional experience in UI/UX Design, Product Design, Digital Design, or a comparable senior design position. A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent UI/UX capabilities, visual design quality, and creative range, particularly across web experiences. Advanced proficiency in Figma, including interactive prototyping and the ability to communicate complex interactions effectively. Strong understanding of UI/UX principles, usability, information architecture and hierarchy, responsive design, and accessibility fundamentals. Excellent visual design skills, with a deliberate and consistent approach to grids, spacing, typography, composition, and layout. Proven experience collaborating closely with developers or other technical teams and understanding the practical considerations involved in implementation. Ability to take an idea from an initial concept or rough brief through user flows, design exploration, prototyping, and a polished final experience. Strong creative problem-solving skills, curiosity, and the ability to challenge conventional approaches when appropriate. Excellent written and verbal English, with confidence presenting designs and articulating the reasoning behind design decisions. Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and collaborate effectively within a fully remote environment. Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript is a plus,

paradigm-paradigm:ashbyhq:0ff72c60-db8c-.description: THE FIRM Paradigm https://www.paradigm.xyz/ is a technology investment firm led by Matt Huang https://www.linkedin.com/in/kmhuang/ and Alana Palmedo https://www.linkedin.com/in/askorniakoffpalmedo/ that builds and invests across crypto, AI, robotics, and other new frontiers from the earliest stages. Founded in 2018, the firm manages over $10 billion and invests across all stages and geographies with offices in San Francisco, New York, and Washington, D.C. We combine deep technical research with hands-on building alongside the founders and teams shaping the frontier. We have backed category-defining companies and protocols that have reshaped how the world transacts, builds, and computes. THE ROLE We're seeking an Events leader to co-create and operationalize powerful, engaging events in collaboration with each functional area at Paradigm (investing, research, policy, marketing, operations). Paradigm's events program exists to support the researchers, builders, founders and technologists shaping the frontier of technology. Some of these events are small, some are large, some have games and adventures, others are technical deep dives. All are close to the metal of what’s getting built at the edges of technology. The person we hire will own the production and execution of events across our portfolio, spanning highly technical research days (e.g., summits for researchers), founder and portfolio-facing gatherings (e.g., founder retreats and fellowships), and institutional or policy-facing convenings (e.g., investor summits and policy programs), as well as recurring community events in our core markets. This role requires close collaboration across the firm and will report to Paradigm's Head of Events, Josie Franciose McGuinn https://www.linkedin.com/in/josie-franciose-mcguinn-96283916/. Being deeply plugged into the San Francisco and frontier tech community is a 10x factor. RESPONSIBILITIES - Plan and execute on a segment of Paradigm events, including production, programming, project management, budgets, and post-event wrap - Drive guest-facing marketing and communication strategy for events - Create unique experiences for a diverse set of high-performing audiences including founders, entrepreneurs, investors, and policymakers - Own venue and vendor relationships and ensure all internal and external stakeholders are kept up-to-date on planning, schedules, and logistics. - Provide day-of event management to deliver high quality, successful, and professional events. - Support large-scale projects across the department - Navigate a fast-paced environment and execute on tight timelines to meet event objectives QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE - 8+ years of events experience owning a mix of events end-to-end including private dinners, receptions, industry events, fireside chats, panels, conferences and summits - Experience creating events in one or more of the following areas: investment & venture, frontier technology, public policy, recruiting, media - Ability to self-manage and prioritize work in a fast-paced environment - Understanding a suite of firm-internal AI tools, and developing your own tools where appropriate - Trustworthy and adept at handling confidential information - High EQ, with the ability to stay calm and be solutions-oriented while resolving last-minute needs in high-visibility situations - Excellent organizational and logistical skills - Outstanding communication skills, verbal and written - Intense curiosity and open-mindedness - Scrappy; willing to roll up sleeves - Team player - Ability to work nights and weekends around events and key deadlines
